title: Brand & Media
intro: Find Common Shade’s logos, visual assets, videos and official channels in one place.
description: Common Shade’s logo files, colours and fonts, shareable images, every film on the site with its captions, and the official social channels, with notes on using them.

rights.content: The site’s text, data, films and illustrations are shared under CC BY 4.0: credit “Common Shade” with a link to https://beattheheat.asia, and say if you made changes.
rights.logo: No licence for the Common Shade name and logo has been published, and the site’s licence file lists names, logos and trademarks among what CC BY 4.0 does not cover. Use the logo to refer or link to Common Shade.
rights.voice: The narration voice in the films is LibriTTS (CC BY 4.0), via Piper.
rights.formal: These are practical notes, not formal brand guidelines. No minimum size, clear space or other formal rule has been set.

usage: Use the files on this page, as they are, rather than copying the logo from a screenshot.
Keep the logo’s proportions: scale it evenly, without stretching or squashing.
Do not crop, recolour, outline, rotate or add effects to the logo.
Choose the version that stays legible: the light-background files on white or cream, the dark-background files on dark colours.
Do not use the logo in a way that suggests Common Shade endorses, funds or partners with an organisation, product or event, unless that has been agreed.
When you show a film or an image, credit Common Shade and link to beattheheat.asia.
